digest.component_or_area: JIRA Data Center adapter / client initialization
propositions: Missing or empty JIRA_PAT environment variable is not validated and falls back to anonymous access instead of failing with a named error as documented
The security guarantee in docs/user-guide.md that a missing JIRA_PAT fails with an error naming the variable is not enforced in the code
An anonymous request to Jira produces a misleading 'project does not exist' error that misattributes credential failure to incorrect project configuration
Settings resolution must remain total to avoid breaking Python 3.11 Protocol conformance checks, requiring the PAT validation to occur at client construction time instead
Empty or whitespace-only PAT values are currently accepted and passed to the Jira client, allowing silent fallback to anonymous access on permissive instances
